summary: MDxHealth SA, a Belgian diagnostics firm, disclosed on Form 6-K that it issued 44,052,862 ordinary shares in a Registered Direct Offering to institutional investors, priced at $0.454 per share, raising approximately $20.0 million net proceeds for working capital and commercialization. The offering, which closed August 13, 2026, was part of an F-3 shelf and included no placement agent. Baker McKenzie provided legal opinion; no board recommendation cited. Post-offering shares outstanding grew to 95,417,382, up from roughly 51.4 million pre-offering, a significant dilution. The registered direct offering is a form of capital raise, distinct from a rights offering or buyback; watch for shareholder dilution sentiment and use of proceeds in product development.
